name: demo-video
description: Use when the user wants a demo, LinkedIn or product video of a web UI or a terminal CLI (through a ttyd browser terminal): zoom-ins on panels recorded with Playwright and an in-page CSS camera, a title card and captions burned from a story script anchored to UI events, red highlight boxes and captions held to the clip's end, sped-up waits, a highlight reel cut from several clips, and narrated reels (voice synthesized with Amazon Polly, the picture waits for the voice) with check_demo.py to audit them; also captions a screen recording (.mov) the user made. Headless Linux, Playwright + ffmpeg, Korean fonts. Fork of hi-space/hi-aws-skills demo-video-recorder 1.2.0 (MIT); 1.3.0 adds terminal scenes, one visible caption look, a single-pass re-encoded reel and Korean font fallbacks. Korean triggers: 데모 영상, 시연 영상, 링크드인 영상, 영상 녹화, 화면 녹화 편집, 자막 넣어줘, 하이라이트 릴, 릴 만들어줘.
